1925, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 1.
Page 26 Cont.
Sept. 6th Paralisis Cured (4.45 A.M. Sept. 7th) Veronica Rose 19, only child, of Albert Rose, Boston Boulivard, paralized now about two yrs. and on her back most of that time recently in considerable pain - is enrolled To-day 2nd time perpetually. Promises are made in her b- half of more frequent Communion - and gift in Honor of little Fl. St. Terese if Veronica be spared.
Page 27
Sept. 17 Busines Leaps since yesterday - Deo Gr! Mrs. R. Forest about 50 of West Lafayette enrolles for 2nd time yesterday as a perpetual mem- ber .... "That my Husband may do better business." To-day reports: "Improvement already." .... Same Mrs. F. had experienced something of the worst rhumatism, had joined perpetually in S.M.A. and prom missed 60 Communions in thanksgiving if same rhumatisme would go a- way. --- "When I had twenty Communions I could Jump like a girl." ---- To-day pays for heathen baby.
Oct. 11th Insanity Cured Dr. Davis, insane drug-fiend, hopelessly dying in Dearborne Asylum and enrolled eight days ago, Oct 3rd for four years -- at the time of enrollment refused absolutely to have the Priest. This evening reported as reconciled to God, and cured. Thanks be to God!
Blind Consumptive resumes teaching her Music Class. Deo Gr! (de- ferred since Apr. 11st Sister N. Immaculate 42 of Chatham Ontario, formerly consumptive not in refectory since November and now go- ing blind is enrolled Apml 13th --- April 21st comes in person "Ventured out almost against their will" and reads without diffi- culty three days after enrollment. Thanks to God Same Sister Mary Imaculata resumes her music teaching three days later Apr. 24 what she had been unable and forbidden by doctors to do before. .... The June Exam's in 1920 "most successful."
Oct. 23rd Bearded baby Baby Jerome Ferry, 10 months old beautiful and bright otherwise shows unwanted beard that might do credit to youth of 17. Six weeks later reported i.e. after enrollment reported improv- ing. Aug. 27 '34 boy J. Ferry was here last week with mother is quite normal - OK. Fr. Sol
